title: PROPX UX after — 22.10.2026

method.server: scripts/kobix-dev-server.mjs on localhost:3305 (perimeter sign-in; no compression — brotli / gzip estimates are computed from the served files)
method.browser: Chromium (Playwright 1.63) headless, a cold context per run; Google Fonts requests aborted for determinism
method.languages: he (default, RTL) and en (LTR, switched with the page's own EN button after load)
method.performance: medians of 6 runs per viewport × language, INTERLEAVED with the other state (before / after alternately, order flipped every run, the same dev server and data) after one unrecorded warm-up — the machine is shared with other workstreams, so separate sequential runs drift by ±20–30 %; DCL / load from Navigation Timing; FCP / LCP / long tasks (> 50 ms) from PerformanceObserver registered before any page script; heap = CDP JSHeapUsedSize after a forced GC; tx table = first row / card of #txTbl / #txCards; street report st:7900:213 (הרצל, פתח תקווה) via openGeoView: core = .sr[data-sr], full = [data-sr-part=full]
method.accessibility: own Playwright checks (no axe): Chromium accessibility tree (CDP getFullAXTree) for unnamed controls / fields / images; DOM scans for ids, tabindex, svgs, labels, touch targets, type sizes; rendered text contrast of every visible text element against its effective background (WCAG AA 4.5:1, 3:1 large); a full Tab walk (focus indicator = outline-style ≠ none or a box-shadow); drawer / search keyboard behaviour; token contrast from the CSS variables in both themes

performanceSequentialRun.note: the same measurements in a separate, non-interleaved session of this state (for drift reference only)

comparison.note: every value is [before, after]; performance = medians of interleaved runs

changes: Launchpad: + "What changed here" (#changes, tile 2) and "Deal Lab" (#dealLab, tile 5), live build only (live:begin / live:end); tiles number themselves (CSS counter) so the offline build reads 1–6; 4 × 2 grid with 8 tiles; I18N lp7 / lp7s / lp8 / lp8s he + en; test/hierarchy.test.js pins 8 live targets + their rail items + the 6 offline ones
Skip links "Skip to search" / "Skip to main content" (the first two Tab stops) that move focus

Search combobox: aria-label, aria-autocomplete, option ids + aria-selected + aria-activedescendant; Escape closes the list (the native search clear used to re-open it) and a late answer no longer re-opens a dismissed list
Names: the transactions period select; decorative header / rail / search / delta-arrow / theme / chevron svgs aria-hidden (30–31 exposed unnamed images → 0)

Contrast: light --ink-3 #7a89a4 → #5e6d89, dark --ink-3 #7c8bab → #8290af, light --conf-high / --conf-med / --conf-low text-safe, light --down #d13438 → #c62f33; new text tokens --brass-ink / --c2-ink (44 brass and 3 compare-slot-2 TEXT colours; --brass stays #a4791c for ALTARIS and for borders / strokes / charts); dark active rail item on #2563eb; sort arrow opacity .38 → .8; build stamp opacity removed

Phone (≤ 759px): ≥ 40px touch targets for the header buttons, language, mode, scope, chips, selects, inputs, segmented / period / tab buttons, rank rows, table sort / filter / mobile controls, search options, range inputs, map zoom, compare-chip remove; 8–9.5px labels → 10.5px, transaction-event chips → 11px
Rail: icons never shrink; desktop rail scrolls (7 items were below a 900px screen, unreachable by pointer) and tightens on screens ≤ 1000px tall; bottom-bar labels on one line
Tape: an LTR figure aligns under its RTL label (the phone inventory figure was pushed off its cell)
Performance: the refresh fade forces one layout for all sections instead of one per section and fades only the sections on screen; preconnect to fonts.gstatic.com
testedAndRejected: Deferring lib/explain/registry.js (690 KB): it evaluates in ≈ 26 ms, and the first render reads it synchronously (renderOrient, xpBtn, the ⓘ marks), so deferring it would need a second full render (≈ 400 ms long task) — kept synchronous
content-visibility:auto on main sections: no measurable gain on desktop (layout 348–415 → 400–549 ms, more layouts)

content-visibility:auto on the phone transaction cards: −40 % load long-task time, but Chromium dropped the text of off-screen cards from the accessibility tree and stripped the names of role="button" board cards — reverted (accessibility over speed)
notChanged: .xp ⓘ buttons (Explain workstream CSS / popover): they are every remaining Tab stop without an outline (focus = border colour only; 116 desktop / 72 phone) and the largest group of sub-40px targets on phone (16 × 16 px)
Type scale (32 distinct sizes 5.5–34 px) and spacing: a global token refactor would touch hundreds of lines across every workstream — only the phone floor was added

The transaction section is 79 % of the DOM (484 table rows + 484 hidden cards ≈ 17,800 of 22,700 elements); rendering only the visible variant or virtualising the list is the largest remaining win, but renderTx is gated by integrity / republished / sales-metrics tests — left for a dedicated change
The Google Fonts stylesheet stays render-blocking (a non-blocking load would swap fonts after a full layout of a 22k-element page)
altaris/altaris.css keeps its own copies of the old tertiary-text tokens
